prompt: What are the lyrics to the popular, unofficial fight song of the university that the main character of Gilmore Girls attended?
answer:
The university is **Yale**, which Rory Gilmore attends. Its popular unofficial fight song is **“Boola Boola.”** A commonly sung version is:

> There’s a sound that’s heard around the world,  
> It’s the sound of the Yale Boola Boola;  
> And when the sons of Eli get together,  
> They sing this song with glee:  
>
> **Boola, Boola, Boola, Boola,**  
> **Boola, Boola, Boola, Boola,**  
> **Boola, Boola, Boola, Boola,**  
> **Boola, Boola—Yale!**

Versions and verses vary; Yale’s official fight song is **“Bulldog,”** written by Cole Porter.
